text: 其中提到，强化财政金融工作协同。省级财政部门要加强与中国人民银行分支机构、金融监管总局派出机构、地方金融管理机构及相关金融机构的协同联动，指导普惠金融发展示范区统筹用好中央奖补资金，提高贷款贴息、融资担保、风险补偿、资本金补充等工作质效，与财政金融协同促内需一揽子政策做好适配，强化效能叠加；普惠金融发展示范区财政部门要聚焦民间投资、科技创新、居民消费等重点领域，加大小微企业融资支持力度，助力扩投资、促消费、稳就业，引导更多金融资源和社会资本投入普惠金融发展示范区建设。（财政部网站）
text_en: It mentions strengthening coordination between fiscal and financial work. Provincial finance departments should enhance collaboration with PBOC branches, NFRA local offices, local financial regulatory bodies, and related financial institutions, guiding inclusive finance development demonstration zones to make coordinated use of central reward funds, improving the quality and efficiency of loan interest subsidies, financing guarantees, risk compensation, and capital replenishment, aligning with the package of fiscal and financial policies to boost domestic demand and amplifying synergy. Finance departments in inclusive finance development demonstration zones should focus on key areas such as private investment, technological innovation, and household consumption, increasing financing support for small and micro enterprises, aiding in expanding investment, boosting consumption, and stabilizing employment, guiding more financial resources and social capital into the construction of inclusive finance development demonstration zones. (Ministry of Finance website)
